content.intro: Introduction to LINQ is lesson 119 in LINQ and Data Querying. LINQ describes data transformations as operators over sequences. Distinguish deferred from immediate execution and avoid repeated expensive enumeration.
content.why_it_matters: LINQ can make data transformations readable, but execution timing and repeated enumeration still matter. This lesson focuses on introduction to linq and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.

content.solution_notes: Suggested approach: identify the expected input and output, start from the smallest example, use the feature only where it clarifies the rule, and verify both a typical case and a boundary/failure case.
